g.text: Title: 01 - Battery input, isolation and Kelvin shunt

g.text: Sheet: /01 - Battery input, isolation and Kelvin shunt/

g.desc: Sheet: /01 - Battery input, isolation and Kelvin shunt/

g.text: PROVISIONAL CIRCUIT / HARNESS DESIGN - NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.desc: PROVISIONAL CIRCUIT / HARNESS DESIGN - NOT FOR FABRICATION

g.text: J pin numbers are proposed harness assignments, not OEM connector pinouts

g.desc: J pin numbers are proposed harness assignments, not OEM connector pinouts

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: R101 is a FOUR-terminal shunt: pins 1/4 carry current; pins 2/3 are Kelvin sense connections to U101 (sheet 02).

g.desc: R101 is a FOUR-terminal shunt: pins 1/4 carry current; pins 2/3 are Kelvin sense connections to U101 (sheet 02).

g.text: This shunt measures load discharge only. Charging bypasses it; BMS must supply total pack charge accounting.

g.desc: This shunt measures load discharge only. Charging bypasses it; BMS must supply total pack charge accounting.

g.text: GND_SYS is the BMS protected return. Do not bypass the BMS with USB grounds, charger returns or chassis bonds.

g.desc: GND_SYS is the BMS protected return. Do not bypass the BMS with USB grounds, charger returns or chassis bonds.

g.text: SW101 OFF isolates loads, not the charging connector. Disconnect the pack and charger before service.

g.desc: SW101 OFF isolates loads, not the charging connector. Disconnect the pack and charger before service.

g.text: OFF-BOARD / NOT RELEASED: cell pack, BMS, pack fuse, isolator and high-current shunt. No DIY cell assembly drawing.

g.desc: OFF-BOARD / NOT RELEASED: cell pack, BMS, pack fuse, isolator and high-current shunt. No DIY cell assembly drawing.

g.text: 1 milliohm: 25A -> 25mV and 0.625W; 40A -> 1.6W. Select pulse rating, thermal margin and terminal geometry.

g.desc: 1 milliohm: 25A -> 25mV and 0.625W; 40A -> 1.6W. Select pulse rating, thermal margin and terminal geometry.

g.text: BATTERY -> MAIN FUSE -> SERVICE SWITCH -> SHUNT -> LOAD BUS

g.desc: BATTERY -> MAIN FUSE -> SERVICE SWITCH -> SHUNT -> LOAD BUS

g.text: UNRESOLVED: whole-system reverse-polarity / surge protection and converter inrush. No placeholder is claimed as protection.

g.desc: UNRESOLVED: whole-system reverse-polarity / surge protection and converter inrush. No placeholder is claimed as protection.

g.text: F101 protects the battery lead. Branch fuses are on sheets 03/05/06. No fuse, cable or contactor rating is final.

g.desc: F101 protects the battery lead. Branch fuses are on sheets 03/05/06. No fuse, cable or contactor rating is final.

g.text: Protected 6S pack only. Charge connection branches BEFORE service switch; see sheet 06.

g.desc: Protected 6S pack only. Charge connection branches BEFORE service switch; see sheet 06.
